rules.summary: In weeks the minor must attend school, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day, 18 hours and 6 consecutive days a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m.

citation.title: HRS § 390-2 — Employment of minors under eighteen years of age
citation.excerpt: No more than eighteen hours in a calendar week during which the minor is legally required to attend school ... (7) No more than three hours on any school day; and (8) No more than eight hours

rules.summary: During school breaks, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day, 40 hours and 6 consecutive days a week, 6 a.m.-9 p.m.

citation.title: HRS § 390-2 — Employment of minors under eighteen years of age
citation.excerpt: Between 7:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. of any day; provided that during any authorized school break, the minor may be employed between 6:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m.
